statement: Harsha Yoga (the 6th house's lord confined to the 6th, 8th, or 12th house) is traditionally read as carrying victory over rivals and adversity contained rather than spreading — a 'bad house' lord kept to bad houses, read as resilience and the capacity to overcome opposition.
editorial_note: Reflects a widely-repeated interpretation found throughout standard Vedic astrological literature, exemplified by (not claimed as a verbatim quotation of) the cited source.
